title: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)
hint: Split into pairs (x_even, x_odd). Compute angles = pos * 1/(10000^(2i/d)). Rotate: [x_e*cos - x_o*sin, x_e*sin + x_o*cos]. Stack and flatten.

description.text: Implement rotary position embedding (RoPE): rotate pairs of dimensions in Q and K by position-dependent angles so relative positions are encoded—standard in many modern LLMs.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
